 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Oscar Piastri makes a cheeky comment on Lando Norris during an F1 Fan Zone session in the ongoing US GP, after things got settled.
 Ahead of the F1 US GP weekend at the Circuit of the Americas, McLaren held internal talks to discuss what transpired in Singapore. Norris committed a heavy mistake by trying to pass teammate Piastri in the sprint that cost them points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Norris raised his hands , but McLaren F1 team principal Andrea Stella was pretty disappointed . The Italian didn't think an apology would work until the mindset changed. The Brit offered help in the main race, which Stella acknowledged.
 But he wants better not just from the drivers, but also from the whole F1 team . Norris understood the assignment and once again apologized, while revealing talks held at Woking to remind them of the things that the drivers already know.
 Norris Understood the Message From His Bosses
 "I'm just fully focused on the weekend," said Norris at the start of the F1 US GP weekend. "Yes, but it's always been settled. Things have always been clear. It's just, I messed up, and I admitted that already last time that I made a mistake. Things have always been settled.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "It's clear in my head what needs to be done, what can and cannot be done. Sometimes I make mistakes. So, that's all it has been. Of course, there's been plenty of talk since between everyone, especially between Andrea and myself, Zak, myself and us as a group, but things have always been clear.
 "Nothing really needed to be cleared up. It wasn't like I wasn't aware of what it was. It was just that I messed up, and I apologize for that," summed up Norris, as Piastri concurred with the Brit about discussions behind the scenes.
 He feels it was dealt with appropriately, as the focus now is to get back to winning ways amid an inconsistent run. "Yeah, I've been happy with how things have been dealt with," said Piastri. "Yeah, I think the team, Zak and Andrea, have handled things the way they should have been, so that's been fine.
 Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri | Photo Credit: McLaren F1 Team
 Piastri Gets Cheeky With Norris
 "Yes, I mean, it's been a challenging year for us, definitely. I think in the middle of the season we felt like we'd gained some momentum, and potentially we were back to being able to fight for wins and regular podiums. But, yes, that's often the way in Formula 1.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "You think you're there again, and you've got a few teams around you to pull you down a few pegs. So, yes, hopefully we can find a bit more performance in the rest of the season. But, yes, I think in terms of going back to Singapore, I think it was dealt with appropriately, and we're ready to go racing," summed up Piastri.
 Outside the serious talks, the Australian was back to himself in an F1 Fan Zone session on Friday. When the moderator asked the drivers about their favorite moment from the 2026 season, while Norris was trying to recall and answer, Piastri popped in to say, "Singapore was pretty good."
 Both shared a good laugh, as did the fans, with Norris mumbling, "Yeah, Singapore, we just wanted to spice it up a little bit. Singapore was great." The two had a mixed Friday outing later on, as they struggled a bit to get things balanced, especially against immediate rivals Mercedes, Red Bull and Ferrari.
